<color=#1a1a1a>去招募<color=#004FCA>农俊豪</color>。

任务难度：<color=#A100FF>困难</color>
任务奖励：宗门贡献+65、正道值 +50、声望+94</color>
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1001.en:
<color=#1a1a1a>Recruit <color=#004FCA>Nong Junhao</color>.

Mission difficulty: <color=#A100FF>Hard</color>
Mission reward: Sect Contribution +65, Righteous Points +50, Reputation +94</color>

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1101.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门领域，驱赶妖兽和敌对宗门弟子，保证宗门领域的安定和平。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1101.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Sect territory, and drive away beasts and hostile Sect Disciple to make the Sect territory stable and peaceful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1102.ch: 现有两名弟子产生纠纷，需要派遣弟子前去判定对错，并进行奖惩，维护宗门弟子间的和谐。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1102.en: There is a dispute between two disciples. Send Disciples to decide who is right and reward and punish to maintain harmony between the Sect Disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1103.ch: 请安排弟子巡查神兽有无异常，若神兽需进食，需投喂神兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1103.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Guardian for abnormalities. Feed the Guardian if it needs to eat.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1104.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的丹药是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1104.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Elixirs in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1105.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的法宝是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1105.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Artifacts in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1106.ch: 宗门神兽需一直镇守于宗内，不可随意离开，请派遣弟子前去陪伴神兽，与神兽聊聊外界的事情，让神兽保持心情愉悦。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1106.en: The Guardian needs to stay in the Sect and cannot just leave as it likes. Please send Disciples to accompany the Guardian in play, and talk to it about the outside world to keep it in a happy mood.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1107.ch: 有一群低级妖兽盘踞于宗门所属领地内，虽说这些低级妖兽无法危害修仙者，但凡人却会因此丧命，因此为了保证凡人的安全，请派遣弟子前去将其全部清剿。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1107.en: There is a group of low-level beasts in the Sect's territory. Though these low-level beasts cannot harm Cultivators, mortals will die because of them. For the safety of the mortals, please send Disciples to clear them all out.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1108.ch: 有一群横行霸道的劫匪常驻再宗门管辖的村落，请派遣弟子前去略加惩罚，并劝诫他们洗心革面重新做人，如若不能就将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1108.en: This is a group of rampaging bandits in one of the villagers under the rule of the Sect. Send Disciples to punish them a little and warn them to mend their ways, or drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1109.ch: 请安排弟子巡查阵法有无异常，及时修复阵法松动处。若有行事诡异之人，需将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1109.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the array for any abnormalities and repair any wear and tear. If there are people behaving strangely, drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11101.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇举办宣传宗门活动，展示本宗绝技，突显本宗实力。宣传本宗招收弟子的要求和福利，吸引弟子加入本宗，扩大宗门的知名度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11101.en: Please send disciples to towns to hold activities to promote the Sect, showcase Sect skills, and highlight the Sect's strength. Make the Sect recruitment requirements and benefits known to attract disciples to join and increase the Sect's popularity.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11102.ch: 妖兽横行，不少凡人村落也因此受到波及，导致他们流离失所，需要派遣弟子前去帮助他们重建家园、救死扶伤。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11102.en: Beasts rampage, and many villages have been affected by them, losing their homes. Please send Disciples to help them rebuild their homes and heal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11103.ch: 请派遣弟子打扫宗门，保证宗门环境整洁亮堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11103.en: Please send disciples to clean the Sect and ensure that the Sect is kept clean and bright.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11104.ch: 修行不易，无宗门依靠的散修和凡人更是艰难，请派遣弟子无偿为他们解答修行中的疑惑，扩大宗门影响力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11104.en: Cultivation is not easy, and it is even more difficult for Cultivators who do not have Sects or are rogue Cultivators. Please send Disciples to answer queries and doubts for free to expand the Sect's influence.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11105.ch: 宗门外的禁制可防止妖兽闯入宗内，但总有妖兽企图突破禁制闯入宗内大肆屠杀，这将会造成宗门内死伤惨重。请派遣弟子前去宗门边界加强禁制。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11105.en: The seal outside the Sect can stop beasts from breaking into the Sect, but there are always beasts trying to break through and kill people, which can end up in great casualties for the Sect. Please send Disciples to the boundary of the Sect to strengthen the seal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11106.ch: 风水之变，需贴切大自然的变换。请派遣弟子使用平日所学的堪舆之术，调整宗门器物布局，以达到趋吉避凶的目的。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11106.en: Feng Shui changes and needs to be in accordance with the change of nature. Please send Disciples to use the art of Geomancy they have learned to adjust the layout of the Sect's things in order to avoid bad luck.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11301.ch: 请派遣弟子前往各地结识天之骄子，为他们介绍本宗的实力以及对于天之骄子的福利待遇。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11301.en: Please send Disciple to all corners of the world to meet the Heaven-chosen, and introduce the strength of the Sect to them, as well as the benefits for Heaven-chosen.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11302.ch: 虽说功法已经习得，但仍需多次练习，方可在实战时熟练使用。请安排弟子参加训练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11302.en: Though Martial Arts have been learned, they must still be practiced for them to be used skillfully in real combat. Please arrange for Disciples to participate in the training.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11303.ch: 我宗弟子皆勤学苦练，但是若有人可指点迷津可帮助他们少走弯路，请派遣弟子前去陪伴外门弟子训练，并为他们解答修炼中的问题。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11303.en: My disciples are all diligent in their studies and practice, but if there is someone who can give them guidance and help them avoid detours, please send inner disciples to accompany the outer disciples in their training and answer their questions about cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11304.ch: 法宝时常能在关键时刻起到重要作用，因此宗门特此安排了炼器课，请安排弟子前去学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11304.en: Artifacts often play an important role in critical moments, so the Sect has specially arranged for a class on forging for Disciples to learn.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11305.ch: 修行路上，丹药是必不可少的。宗门长期有传授炼丹的课程，请安排弟子前去参加，精进炼丹之术。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11305.en: Elixirs are a must on the path to cultivation. The Sect has a long-standing course on Alchemy, so please arrange for Disciples to participate and refine the art of alchemy.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11306.ch: 请安排弟子组织并参加交流音律的活动，感受丝竹管弦的魅力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11306.en: We invite you to join our disciples organization, where we gather to discuss music theory and immerse ourselves in the enchanting world of classical orchestral music.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11307.ch: 百练不如一战，请派遣弟子前往宗门附近，清剿一些低级妖兽，增加实战经验。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11307.en: A hundred practice sessions pale in comparison to one real battle. Please send Disciples nearby the Sect to clear some low-level beasts and increase true battle experience.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11308.ch: 宗门内有安排天骄弟子来教授道法，请派遣弟子前去刻苦学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11308.en: The Sect has arranged for a Heaven-chosen to teach Taoism. Please send Disciples to study hard.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11601.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的功法交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，便于弟子们更容易获得合适的功法。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11601.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Martial Arts to the Sect. Other Disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Martial Arts more easily.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11602.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的丹药和法宝交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，使得弟子们更容易获得合适的丹药和法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11602.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Elixirs and Artifacts to the Sect. Other disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Elixirs and Artifacts more easily now.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11603.ch: 炼丹之事，熟能生巧。请派遣弟子将宗门仓库内的药材，炼制成丹药，即能练习该弟子的炼丹技艺，又可增加宗门内的丹药储备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11603.en: Practice makes perfect in Alchemy. Please send Disciples to use the herbs in the Sect's warehouse to refine Elixirs and practice their Artisanship to increase the Sect's Elixir reserves.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11604.ch: 宗门内现有大量弟子上交的法宝材料，需要派遣弟子前去炼制成法宝，炼制完成后可自行挑选一件合适的法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11604.en: There is a large number of Artifact materials brought in by the Disciples. Please send Disciples to forge them into Artifacts, and choose a suitable Artifact for yourself after forging.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11605.ch: 现有部分弟子被救回宗门，但还需弟子辅助运气疗伤，疗伤院人手不足，请派遣弟子前去协助。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11605.en: Currently, some of our disciples have been rescued back to the sect but still need assistance in healing their injuries through energy manipulation. The medical facility is understaffed, so please send disciples to help.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11606.ch: 这世道越发不太平，妖兽肆虐横行，请派遣弟子夜观星宿，观察是否有异象。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11606.en: The world is becoming more unstable, with beasts running rampant. Please send Disciples to observe the constellations at night and see if there is anything strange.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11607.ch: 宗门有一弟子因一时失误，被大妖兽击伤，请派遣弟子前去援救他。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11607.en: A Sect disciple was injured by a Mythical Beast due to a mistake. Please send Disciples to rescue him.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11701.ch: 敌方宗门内有一位大能修士，因受重伤法力导致近乎全无，他为了躲避追杀躲入了我宗管辖的村庄内，村民恐惧万分，因此申请我宗派遣弟子前去击杀。请派遣弟子前去完成此任务，消除村民们的隐患。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11701.en: The enemy Sect has a powerful Cultivator who almost lost everything because of a serious injury. He is hiding from his pursuers in a village under our Sect's jurisdiction. The villagers are terrified and they have requested our Sect to send Disciples to kill him. Please send Disciples to complete this Mission and eliminate the hidden danger to the villagers.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11702.ch: 有弟子发现某地有一秘境有大妖兽的气息，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11702.en: A Disciple has found a Mystic Realm with the Breath of a Mythical Beast in a certain place. Please send Disciples to investigate.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11703.ch: 有弟子发现某地出现异象，似有异宝出世，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11703.en: A disciple has discovered anomalies in a certain place, and it seems a strange treasure has appeared. Please send Disciples to investigate this.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11704.ch: 请派遣弟子前去击杀宗门附近的大妖兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11704.en: Send Disciples to kill the Mythical Beast near the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11705.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里总有奇怪的事件发生，请派遣弟子前往该区域查探情况，使用堪舆术找出异象胜出的根源，并将其解决。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11705.en: There are always strange events happening in the villages under the Sect's jurisdiction. Send Disciples to the area to investigate the situation and use Geomancy to find out the root cause of the appearance of the anomaly and solve it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11706.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇酒馆打探有关神秘组织的情报。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11706.en: Send Disciples to the town tavern to get information about the mysterious group.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11707.ch: 宗门附近有一妖兽巢穴曾被弟子们清剿过，如今又有妖兽聚集于此，若长此以往发展下去将会生出大妖兽，对宗门造成危害，请趁此地妖兽尚且不多，派遣弟子前去清扫。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11707.en: There is a Monster Lair close to the Sect that the disciples have cleared out before, but beasts are gathering there once more. It will become a big problem for the Sect if Mythical Beasts appear there. Please send Disciples to clear the areas while there are not so many beasts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11708.ch: 宗门的灵脉因吸收天地灵气，生出了一条较为稀薄的灵脉，请派遣弟子前去设置阵法将其灵气引入宗门的灵阁内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc11708.en: The spiritual vein of the Sect has branched a thinner one due to the absorption of Qi. Please set a Disciple to draw the Qi to the Sect's Spirit Pavilion.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12404.ch: 修行不易，无宗门依靠的散修和凡人更是艰难，请派遣弟子无偿为他们解答修行中的疑惑，扩大宗门影响力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12404.en: Cultivation is not easy, and it is even more difficult for Cultivators who do not have Sects or are rogue Cultivators. Please send Disciples to answer queries and doubts for free to expand the Sect's influence.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12405.ch: 宗门外的禁制可防止妖兽闯入宗内，但总有妖兽企图突破禁制闯入宗内大肆屠杀，这将会造成宗门内死伤惨重。请派遣弟子前去宗门边界加强禁制。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12405.en: The seal outside the Sect can stop beasts from breaking into the Sect, but there are always beasts trying to break through and kill people, which can end up in great casualties for the Sect. Please send Disciples to the boundary of the Sect to strengthen the seal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12406.ch: 风水之变，需贴切大自然的变换。请派遣弟子使用平日所学的堪舆之术，调整宗门器物布局，以达到趋吉避凶的目的。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12406.en: Feng Shui changes and needs to be in accordance with the change of nature. Please send Disciples to use the art of Geomancy they have learned to adjust the layout of the Sect's things in order to avoid bad luck.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12601.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的功法交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，便于弟子们更容易获得合适的功法。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12601.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Martial Arts to the Sect. Other Disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Martial Arts more easily.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12602.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的丹药和法宝交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，使得弟子们更容易获得合适的丹药和法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12602.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Elixirs and Artifacts to the Sect. Other disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Elixirs and Artifacts more easily now.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12603.ch: 炼丹之事，熟能生巧。请派遣弟子将宗门仓库内的药材，炼制成丹药，即能练习该弟子的炼丹技艺，又可增加宗门内的丹药储备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12603.en: Practice makes perfect in Alchemy. Please send Disciples to use the herbs in the Sect's warehouse to refine Elixirs and practice their Artisanship to increase the Sect's Elixir reserves.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12604.ch: 宗门内现有大量弟子上交的法宝材料，需要派遣弟子前去炼制成法宝，炼制完成后可自行挑选一件合适的法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12604.en: There is a large number of Artifact materials brought in by the Disciples. Please send Disciples to forge them into Artifacts, and choose a suitable Artifact for yourself after forging.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12605.ch: 现有部分弟子被救回宗门，但还需弟子辅助运气疗伤，疗伤院人手不足，请派遣弟子前去协助。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12605.en: Currently, some of our disciples have been rescued back to the sect but still need assistance in healing their injuries through energy manipulation. The medical facility is understaffed, so please send disciples to help.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12606.ch: 这世道越发不太平，妖兽肆虐横行，请派遣弟子夜观星宿，观察是否有异象。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12606.en: The world is becoming more unstable, with beasts running rampant. Please send Disciples to observe the constellations at night and see if there is anything strange.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12607.ch: 宗门有一弟子因一时失误，被大妖兽击伤，请派遣弟子前去援救他。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12607.en: A Sect disciple was injured by a Mythical Beast due to a mistake. Please send Disciples to rescue him.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12701.ch: 敌方宗门内有一位大能修士，因受重伤法力导致近乎全无，他为了躲避追杀躲入了我宗管辖的村庄内，村民恐惧万分，因此申请我宗派遣弟子前去击杀。请派遣弟子前去完成此任务，消除村民们的隐患。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12701.en: The enemy Sect has a powerful Cultivator who almost lost everything because of a serious injury. He is hiding from his pursuers in a village under our Sect's jurisdiction. The villagers are terrified and they have requested our Sect to send Disciples to kill him. Please send Disciples to complete this Mission and eliminate the hidden danger to the villagers.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12702.ch: 有弟子发现某地有一秘境有大妖兽的气息，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12702.en: A Disciple has found a Mystic Realm with the Breath of a Mythical Beast in a certain place. Please send Disciples to investigate.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12703.ch: 有弟子发现某地出现异象，似有异宝出世，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12703.en: A disciple has discovered anomalies in a certain place, and it seems a strange treasure has appeared. Please send Disciples to investigate this.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12704.ch: 请派遣弟子前去击杀宗门附近的大妖兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12704.en: Send Disciples to kill the Mythical Beast near the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12705.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里总有奇怪的事件发生，请派遣弟子前往该区域查探情况，使用堪舆术找出异象胜出的根源，并将其解决。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12705.en: There are always strange events happening in the villages under the Sect's jurisdiction. Send Disciples to the area to investigate the situation and use Geomancy to find out the root cause of the appearance of the anomaly and solve it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12706.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇酒馆打探有关神秘组织的情报。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12706.en: Send Disciples to the town tavern to get information about the mysterious group.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12707.ch: 宗门附近有一妖兽巢穴曾被弟子们清剿过，如今又有妖兽聚集于此，若长此以往发展下去将会生出大妖兽，对宗门造成危害，请趁此地妖兽尚且不多，派遣弟子前去清扫。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12707.en: There is a Monster Lair close to the Sect that the disciples have cleared out before, but beasts are gathering there once more. It will become a big problem for the Sect if Mythical Beasts appear there. Please send Disciples to clear the areas while there are not so many beasts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12708.ch: 宗门的灵脉因吸收天地灵气，生出了一条较为稀薄的灵脉，请派遣弟子前去设置阵法将其灵气引入宗门的灵阁内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc12708.en: The spiritual vein of the Sect has branched a thinner one due to the absorption of Qi. Please set a Disciple to draw the Qi to the Sect's Spirit Pavilion.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1301.ch: 请派遣弟子外出招纳记名弟子。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1301.en: Send disciples out to recruit backup disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1302.ch: 请派遣弟子为新弟子们介绍宗门的历史，现状和未来发展规划，让新弟子们尽快熟悉并融入宗门。引导新弟子加入合适的分堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1302.en: Send Disciples to introduce new disciples to the Sect history, current situation, and future development so they can get familiar with the Sect and integrate as soon as possible, Guide new disciple to join appropriate branches.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1303.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇的常驻招收弟子处，告知常驻人员应加大招收新弟子的力度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1303.en: Send Disciples to visit the town post where disciple recruitment is carried out and inform the staff that they should increase their recruitment efforts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1304.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里有时也会有凡人生出灵根，需要派遣弟子前往凡人村庄，组织灵根测试，邀请资质优良的凡人加入本宗。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1304.en: Villages under the jurisdiction of the Sect sometimes have mortals who also have Spiritual Root. Send Disciples to visit the villages, organize Spiritual Root tests, and invite mortals with good stats to join the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1305.ch: 请派遣弟子将新入门的弟子和退出宗门的弟子记录在档，并分析弟子退宗原因。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1305.en: Send Disciples to keep a record of new disciples and those who left the Sect, and analyze the reasons why disciples left the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1306.ch: 修仙之路，既要修境界，也要修人情。请派遣弟子为其他弟子们讲解世情人理，教导他们修仙途中的为人处世。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1306.en: The path of cultivation requires cultivation of the Realm and also of human feelings. Send Disciples to explain the concept of worldly feelings to the disciples, and teach them how to deal with people on the Path of cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1307.ch: 请派遣一名弟子带领其他弟子们互相切磋，让弟子们可在切磋中对招式领悟的更加深刻、熟练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1307.en: Send Disciples to lead the other Disciples in a spar against each other so they can have a deeper and more effective understanding of moves during sparring.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13101.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇举办宣传宗门活动，展示本宗绝技，突显本宗实力。宣传本宗招收弟子的要求和福利，吸引弟子加入本宗，扩大宗门的知名度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13101.en: Please send disciples to towns to hold activities to promote the Sect, showcase Sect skills, and highlight the Sect's strength. Make the Sect recruitment requirements and benefits known to attract disciples to join and increase the Sect's popularity.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13102.ch: 妖兽横行，不少凡人村落也因此受到波及，导致他们流离失所，需要派遣弟子前去帮助他们重建家园、救死扶伤。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13102.en: Beasts rampage, and many villages have been affected by them, losing their homes. Please send Disciples to help them rebuild their homes and heal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13103.ch: 请派遣弟子打扫宗门，保证宗门环境整洁亮堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13103.en: Please send disciples to clean the Sect and ensure that the Sect is kept clean and bright.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13301.en: Please send Disciple to all corners of the world to meet the Heaven-chosen, and introduce the strength of the Sect to them, as well as the benefits for Heaven-chosen.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13302.ch: 虽说功法已经习得，但仍需多次练习，方可在实战时熟练使用。请安排弟子参加训练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13302.en: Though Martial Arts have been learned, they must still be practiced for them to be used skillfully in real combat. Please arrange for Disciples to participate in the training.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13303.ch: 我宗弟子皆勤学苦练，但是若有人可指点迷津可帮助他们少走弯路，请派遣弟子前去陪伴外门弟子训练，并为他们解答修炼中的问题。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13303.en: My disciples are all diligent in their studies and practice, but if there is someone who can give them guidance and help them avoid detours, please send inner disciples to accompany the outer disciples in their training and answer their questions about cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13304.ch: 法宝时常能在关键时刻起到重要作用，因此宗门特此安排了炼器课，请安排弟子前去学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13304.en: Artifacts often play an important role in critical moments, so the Sect has specially arranged for a class on forging for Disciples to learn.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13305.ch: 修行路上，丹药是必不可少的。宗门长期有传授炼丹的课程，请安排弟子前去参加，精进炼丹之术。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13305.en: Elixirs are a must on the path to cultivation. The Sect has a long-standing course on Alchemy, so please arrange for Disciples to participate and refine the art of alchemy.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13306.ch: 请安排弟子组织并参加交流音律的活动，感受丝竹管弦的魅力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13306.en: We invite you to join our disciples organization, where we gather to discuss music theory and immerse ourselves in the enchanting world of classical orchestral music.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13307.ch: 百练不如一战，请派遣弟子前往宗门附近，清剿一些低级妖兽，增加实战经验。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13307.en: A hundred practice sessions pale in comparison to one real battle. Please send Disciples nearby the Sect to clear some low-level beasts and increase true battle experience.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13308.ch: 宗门内有安排天骄弟子来教授道法，请派遣弟子前去刻苦学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc13308.en: The Sect has arranged for a Heaven-chosen to teach Taoism. Please send Disciples to study hard.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1401.ch: 其他宗门的弟子将来我宗访问，请派遣弟子前去接待他们，陪伴其游玩，并介绍本宗的历史。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1401.en: When disciples from other Sects come visit, please send Disciples to receive them. Accompany them on a tour and introduce them to the history of our Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1402.ch: 请派遣弟子将近期其他宗门的赠礼情况记录下来，并逐一回礼。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1402.en: Please send Disciples to record the gifts sent recently by other Sects, and send a returning gift.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1403.ch: 有散修发现一处秘境，但由于自身实力不足向我宗求助，请派遣弟子协助这名散修。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1403.en: A rogue Cultivator has discovered a Mystic Realm but due to his lack of strength, he asks our Sect for assistance. Please send Disciples to assist this rogue Cultivator.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1404.ch: 请派遣弟子向各大宗门的宗主飞鸽传书，阐述本宗门与其他宗门交往的规则。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1404.en: Please send Disciples to send a pigeon to the Sect Leaders of the various great Sects to explain the rules of interaction with other Sects.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1405.ch: 宗门实力日益增强，人口也在渐渐增加，现计划将宗门仓库扩大，需要派遣弟子前去参与仓库扩建任务。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1405.en: The might of the Sect is growing and the population is gradually increasing. We plan to expand the warehouse now. We need Disciple to be sent to participate in the warehouse expansion Mission.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1406.ch: 宗门传送阵的每次运转都一定耗损，请派遣弟子前去维护传送阵，以保证其正常运行。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1406.en: The Sect Portal is depleted by a certain amount every time it is used, Please send Disciples to make sure the Portal works normally.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1407.ch: 灵阁的使用极其频繁，导致灵气偶有散失，需要派遣弟子前去将灵阵修缮，保证全部灵气都聚集于阵内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1407.en: The Spirit Pavilion is used frequently and causes occasional loss of Qi. Please send Disciples to repair the array to ensure all Qi is gathered in the array.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1408.ch: 宗门内灵气旺盛，草植也因此生长的迅速，因此需要派遣弟子前去将宗内花草植物修剪美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1408.en: The Qi in the Sect is strong, and plants and grasses are growing well. Please send Disciples to trim the flowers and plants in the Sect to be neat and beautiful

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1409.ch: 宗门建设的材料已收集齐，需要派遣弟子按照规划重建宗门外部围墙，使宗门外观更加完善、美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1409.en: The materials for the construction of the Sect have been gathered. Send your Disciples to rebuild the outer wall according to the plan to make the look of the Sect more perfect and beautiful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14101.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇举办宣传宗门活动，展示本宗绝技，突显本宗实力。宣传本宗招收弟子的要求和福利，吸引弟子加入本宗，扩大宗门的知名度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14101.en: Please send disciples to towns to hold activities to promote the Sect, showcase Sect skills, and highlight the Sect's strength. Make the Sect recruitment requirements and benefits known to attract disciples to join and increase the Sect's popularity.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14102.ch: 妖兽横行，不少凡人村落也因此受到波及，导致他们流离失所，需要派遣弟子前去帮助他们重建家园、救死扶伤。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14102.en: Beasts rampage, and many villages have been affected by them, losing their homes. Please send Disciples to help them rebuild their homes and heal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14103.ch: 请派遣弟子打扫宗门，保证宗门环境整洁亮堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14103.en: Please send disciples to clean the Sect and ensure that the Sect is kept clean and bright.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14104.ch: 修行不易，无宗门依靠的散修和凡人更是艰难，请派遣弟子无偿为他们解答修行中的疑惑，扩大宗门影响力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14104.en: Cultivation is not easy, and it is even more difficult for Cultivators who do not have Sects or are rogue Cultivators. Please send Disciples to answer queries and doubts for free to expand the Sect's influence.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14105.ch: 宗门外的禁制可防止妖兽闯入宗内，但总有妖兽企图突破禁制闯入宗内大肆屠杀，这将会造成宗门内死伤惨重。请派遣弟子前去宗门边界加强禁制。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14105.en: The seal outside the Sect can stop beasts from breaking into the Sect, but there are always beasts trying to break through and kill people, which can end up in great casualties for the Sect. Please send Disciples to the boundary of the Sect to strengthen the seal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14106.ch: 风水之变，需贴切大自然的变换。请派遣弟子使用平日所学的堪舆之术，调整宗门器物布局，以达到趋吉避凶的目的。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14106.en: Feng Shui changes and needs to be in accordance with the change of nature. Please send Disciples to use the art of Geomancy they have learned to adjust the layout of the Sect's things in order to avoid bad luck.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14301.ch: 请派遣弟子前往各地结识天之骄子，为他们介绍本宗的实力以及对于天之骄子的福利待遇。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14301.en: Please send Disciple to all corners of the world to meet the Heaven-chosen, and introduce the strength of the Sect to them, as well as the benefits for Heaven-chosen.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14302.ch: 虽说功法已经习得，但仍需多次练习，方可在实战时熟练使用。请安排弟子参加训练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14302.en: Though Martial Arts have been learned, they must still be practiced for them to be used skillfully in real combat. Please arrange for Disciples to participate in the training.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14303.ch: 我宗弟子皆勤学苦练，但是若有人可指点迷津可帮助他们少走弯路，请派遣弟子前去陪伴外门弟子训练，并为他们解答修炼中的问题。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14303.en: My disciples are all diligent in their studies and practice, but if there is someone who can give them guidance and help them avoid detours, please send inner disciples to accompany the outer disciples in their training and answer their questions about cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14304.ch: 法宝时常能在关键时刻起到重要作用，因此宗门特此安排了炼器课，请安排弟子前去学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14304.en: Artifacts often play an important role in critical moments, so the Sect has specially arranged for a class on forging for Disciples to learn.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14305.ch: 修行路上，丹药是必不可少的。宗门长期有传授炼丹的课程，请安排弟子前去参加，精进炼丹之术。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14305.en: Elixirs are a must on the path to cultivation. The Sect has a long-standing course on Alchemy, so please arrange for Disciples to participate and refine the art of alchemy.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14306.ch: 请安排弟子组织并参加交流音律的活动，感受丝竹管弦的魅力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14306.en: We invite you to join our disciples organization, where we gather to discuss music theory and immerse ourselves in the enchanting world of classical orchestral music.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14307.ch: 百练不如一战，请派遣弟子前往宗门附近，清剿一些低级妖兽，增加实战经验。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14307.en: A hundred practice sessions pale in comparison to one real battle. Please send Disciples nearby the Sect to clear some low-level beasts and increase true battle experience.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14308.ch: 宗门内有安排天骄弟子来教授道法，请派遣弟子前去刻苦学习。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14308.en: The Sect has arranged for a Heaven-chosen to teach Taoism. Please send Disciples to study hard.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14601.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的功法交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，便于弟子们更容易获得合适的功法。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14601.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Martial Arts to the Sect. Other Disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Martial Arts more easily.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14602.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的丹药和法宝交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，使得弟子们更容易获得合适的丹药和法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14602.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Elixirs and Artifacts to the Sect. Other disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Elixirs and Artifacts more easily now.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14603.ch: 炼丹之事，熟能生巧。请派遣弟子将宗门仓库内的药材，炼制成丹药，即能练习该弟子的炼丹技艺，又可增加宗门内的丹药储备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14603.en: Practice makes perfect in Alchemy. Please send Disciples to use the herbs in the Sect's warehouse to refine Elixirs and practice their Artisanship to increase the Sect's Elixir reserves.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14604.ch: 宗门内现有大量弟子上交的法宝材料，需要派遣弟子前去炼制成法宝，炼制完成后可自行挑选一件合适的法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14604.en: There is a large number of Artifact materials brought in by the Disciples. Please send Disciples to forge them into Artifacts, and choose a suitable Artifact for yourself after forging.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14605.ch: 现有部分弟子被救回宗门，但还需弟子辅助运气疗伤，疗伤院人手不足，请派遣弟子前去协助。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14605.en: Currently, some of our disciples have been rescued back to the sect but still need assistance in healing their injuries through energy manipulation. The medical facility is understaffed, so please send disciples to help.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14606.ch: 这世道越发不太平，妖兽肆虐横行，请派遣弟子夜观星宿，观察是否有异象。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14606.en: The world is becoming more unstable, with beasts running rampant. Please send Disciples to observe the constellations at night and see if there is anything strange.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14607.ch: 宗门有一弟子因一时失误，被大妖兽击伤，请派遣弟子前去援救他。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14607.en: A Sect disciple was injured by a Mythical Beast due to a mistake. Please send Disciples to rescue him.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14701.ch: 敌方宗门内有一位大能修士，因受重伤法力导致近乎全无，他为了躲避追杀躲入了我宗管辖的村庄内，村民恐惧万分，因此申请我宗派遣弟子前去击杀。请派遣弟子前去完成此任务，消除村民们的隐患。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14701.en: The enemy Sect has a powerful Cultivator who almost lost everything because of a serious injury. He is hiding from his pursuers in a village under our Sect's jurisdiction. The villagers are terrified and they have requested our Sect to send Disciples to kill him. Please send Disciples to complete this Mission and eliminate the hidden danger to the villagers.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14702.ch: 有弟子发现某地有一秘境有大妖兽的气息，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14702.en: A Disciple has found a Mystic Realm with the Breath of a Mythical Beast in a certain place. Please send Disciples to investigate.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14703.ch: 有弟子发现某地出现异象，似有异宝出世，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14703.en: A disciple has discovered anomalies in a certain place, and it seems a strange treasure has appeared. Please send Disciples to investigate this.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14704.ch: 请派遣弟子前去击杀宗门附近的大妖兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14704.en: Send Disciples to kill the Mythical Beast near the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14705.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里总有奇怪的事件发生，请派遣弟子前往该区域查探情况，使用堪舆术找出异象胜出的根源，并将其解决。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14705.en: There are always strange events happening in the villages under the Sect's jurisdiction. Send Disciples to the area to investigate the situation and use Geomancy to find out the root cause of the appearance of the anomaly and solve it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14706.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇酒馆打探有关神秘组织的情报。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14706.en: Send Disciples to the town tavern to get information about the mysterious group.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14707.ch: 宗门附近有一妖兽巢穴曾被弟子们清剿过，如今又有妖兽聚集于此，若长此以往发展下去将会生出大妖兽，对宗门造成危害，请趁此地妖兽尚且不多，派遣弟子前去清扫。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14707.en: There is a Monster Lair close to the Sect that the disciples have cleared out before, but beasts are gathering there once more. It will become a big problem for the Sect if Mythical Beasts appear there. Please send Disciples to clear the areas while there are not so many beasts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14708.ch: 宗门的灵脉因吸收天地灵气，生出了一条较为稀薄的灵脉，请派遣弟子前去设置阵法将其灵气引入宗门的灵阁内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc14708.en: The spiritual vein of the Sect has branched a thinner one due to the absorption of Qi. Please set a Disciple to draw the Qi to the Sect's Spirit Pavilion.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15405.en: The seal outside the Sect can stop beasts from breaking into the Sect, but there are always beasts trying to break through and kill people, which can end up in great casualties for the Sect. Please send Disciples to the boundary of the Sect to strengthen the seal.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15406.ch: 风水之变，需贴切大自然的变换。请派遣弟子使用平日所学的堪舆之术，调整宗门器物布局，以达到趋吉避凶的目的。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15406.en: Feng Shui changes and needs to be in accordance with the change of nature. Please send Disciples to use the art of Geomancy they have learned to adjust the layout of the Sect's things in order to avoid bad luck.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15601.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的功法交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，便于弟子们更容易获得合适的功法。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15601.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Martial Arts to the Sect. Other Disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Martial Arts more easily.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15602.ch: 请派遣弟子将自身不合适的丹药和法宝交予宗门，其他弟子将可通过完成任务或贡献值兑换的方式得到，使得弟子们更容易获得合适的丹药和法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15602.en: Please send Disciples to hand unsuitable Elixirs and Artifacts to the Sect. Other disciples will be able to get them by completing Missions or exchanging them with contribution points. Disciples can obtain suitable Elixirs and Artifacts more easily now.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15603.ch: 炼丹之事，熟能生巧。请派遣弟子将宗门仓库内的药材，炼制成丹药，即能练习该弟子的炼丹技艺，又可增加宗门内的丹药储备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15603.en: Practice makes perfect in Alchemy. Please send Disciples to use the herbs in the Sect's warehouse to refine Elixirs and practice their Artisanship to increase the Sect's Elixir reserves.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15604.ch: 宗门内现有大量弟子上交的法宝材料，需要派遣弟子前去炼制成法宝，炼制完成后可自行挑选一件合适的法宝。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15604.en: There is a large number of Artifact materials brought in by the Disciples. Please send Disciples to forge them into Artifacts, and choose a suitable Artifact for yourself after forging.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15605.ch: 现有部分弟子被救回宗门，但还需弟子辅助运气疗伤，疗伤院人手不足，请派遣弟子前去协助。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15605.en: Currently, some of our disciples have been rescued back to the sect but still need assistance in healing their injuries through energy manipulation. The medical facility is understaffed, so please send disciples to help.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15606.ch: 这世道越发不太平，妖兽肆虐横行，请派遣弟子夜观星宿，观察是否有异象。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15606.en: The world is becoming more unstable, with beasts running rampant. Please send Disciples to observe the constellations at night and see if there is anything strange.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15607.ch: 宗门有一弟子因一时失误，被大妖兽击伤，请派遣弟子前去援救他。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15607.en: A Sect disciple was injured by a Mythical Beast due to a mistake. Please send Disciples to rescue him.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15701.ch: 敌方宗门内有一位大能修士，因受重伤法力导致近乎全无，他为了躲避追杀躲入了我宗管辖的村庄内，村民恐惧万分，因此申请我宗派遣弟子前去击杀。请派遣弟子前去完成此任务，消除村民们的隐患。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15701.en: The enemy Sect has a powerful Cultivator who almost lost everything because of a serious injury. He is hiding from his pursuers in a village under our Sect's jurisdiction. The villagers are terrified and they have requested our Sect to send Disciples to kill him. Please send Disciples to complete this Mission and eliminate the hidden danger to the villagers.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15702.ch: 有弟子发现某地有一秘境有大妖兽的气息，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15702.en: A Disciple has found a Mystic Realm with the Breath of a Mythical Beast in a certain place. Please send Disciples to investigate.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15703.ch: 有弟子发现某地出现异象，似有异宝出世，请派遣弟子前去一探究竟。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15703.en: A disciple has discovered anomalies in a certain place, and it seems a strange treasure has appeared. Please send Disciples to investigate this.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15704.ch: 请派遣弟子前去击杀宗门附近的大妖兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15704.en: Send Disciples to kill the Mythical Beast near the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15705.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里总有奇怪的事件发生，请派遣弟子前往该区域查探情况，使用堪舆术找出异象胜出的根源，并将其解决。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15705.en: There are always strange events happening in the villages under the Sect's jurisdiction. Send Disciples to the area to investigate the situation and use Geomancy to find out the root cause of the appearance of the anomaly and solve it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15706.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇酒馆打探有关神秘组织的情报。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15706.en: Send Disciples to the town tavern to get information about the mysterious group.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15707.ch: 宗门附近有一妖兽巢穴曾被弟子们清剿过，如今又有妖兽聚集于此，若长此以往发展下去将会生出大妖兽，对宗门造成危害，请趁此地妖兽尚且不多，派遣弟子前去清扫。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15707.en: There is a Monster Lair close to the Sect that the disciples have cleared out before, but beasts are gathering there once more. It will become a big problem for the Sect if Mythical Beasts appear there. Please send Disciples to clear the areas while there are not so many beasts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15708.ch: 宗门的灵脉因吸收天地灵气，生出了一条较为稀薄的灵脉，请派遣弟子前去设置阵法将其灵气引入宗门的灵阁内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc15708.en: The spiritual vein of the Sect has branched a thinner one due to the absorption of Qi. Please set a Disciple to draw the Qi to the Sect's Spirit Pavilion.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1601.ch: 请派遣弟子向每名弟子发送信件：无论你是刚加入本宗，还是已入宗多年，都应时时刻刻遵守门规，维护本宗的名誉，切勿做出损害宗门之事。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1601.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to every disciple: Whether you've just joined the Sect or have been with us for many years, you should always abide by the rules and uphold the Prestige of the Sect. Do not do anything to harm the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1602.ch: 请派遣弟子向境界提升的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的祝贺。向近期陷入困难的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的关心和慰问。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1602.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to Disciples who upgraded their Realm to express congratulations to the Sect. Send letters to the disciples who have recently fallen on hard times, expressing the Sect's concern and condolences.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1603.ch: 宗门附近有大大小小许多灵脉，八荒中流通的灵石都从其中产生，请派遣弟子前往进行开采，为宗门增加灵石收入。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1603.en: There are Spirit Veins of various sizes near the Sect from which Spirit Stones are generated. Please send Disciples to carry out mining and increase the Spirit Stone income of the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1604.ch: 八荒地下埋藏着许多秘宝，请派遣擅长风水堪舆的弟子去宗门外探寻宝物，以壮大宗门。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1604.en: There are many Treasures hidden underground. Please send Disciples who are good at Feng Shui Geomancy to explore and search around the Sect for Treasures to strengthen the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1605.ch: 拍卖会虽两年召开一次，但其筹备工作也十分复杂繁琐，请派遣弟子协助城镇拍卖会的筹备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1605.en: The auction is held once every two years, but the preparation work is very complicated and tedious. Please send Disciples to assist in the preparation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1606.ch: 八荒之中，大到各宗、小到各人，彼此都有所长，只有互通有无才能实现良性发展，请派遣弟子与其他修士交易我宗之物以换取灵石。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1606.en: All Sects and people have their own strengths, and only through mutual exchange can we achieve healthy development. Please send Disciples to trade with other Cultivators and exchange Spirit Stones.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1607.ch: 宗门附近有一处风光正好的美景，请安排弟子一同前去游山玩水、品茗对弈，放松心情。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1607.en: There is a beautiful place near the Sect where the scenery is wonderful. Please arrange for Disciples to play in the mountains, drink tea, and play games to relax.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1608.ch: 请派遣弟子前去召集有闲暇的弟子们回到宗门，谈谈修炼途中的趣事，交流修炼的心得。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1608.en: Please send Disciples to gather Disciples who have spare time to return to the Sect to talk about interesting things in cultivation and exchange cultivation knowledge.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1701.ch: 知己知彼，百战不殆。请派遣弟子偷偷潜入敌对宗门，将其攻击阵法记录下来，为避免以后的开战束手无策。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1701.en: If you know yourself and your opponent, you will never lose a hundred battles. Please send Disciples to sneak into the hostile Sect and record their array to avoid being caught unawares in future battles.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1702.ch: 有一修为低下的敌对宗门弟子总再寻衅滋事，请派遣一名弟子秘密将其击杀。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1702.en: There is a disciple of a hostile Sect with low cultivation who always stirs up trouble. Please send Disciples to kill him in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1703.ch: 请派遣弟子乔装成敌对宗门弟子，暗中了解敌对宗门的实力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1703.en: Please send Disciples to disguise themselves as a Disciples of a hostile Sect and learn about the strength of that Sect in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1704.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的矿材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1704.en: There is a newly-discovered ore resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1705.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的药材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1705.en: There is a newly-discovered herb resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1706.ch: 有弟子发现一处宗门遗址，请派遣弟子前去探索其中是否有宝物。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1706.en: A Disciple has discovered Sect ruins. Please send Disciples to explore and see if there are any treasures in them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1707.ch: 有弟子发现一处药园，请派遣弟子前去将药材收集回来。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc1707.en: A Disciple has discovered a herb garden. Please send Disciples to collect herbs.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2101.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门领域，驱赶妖兽和敌对宗门弟子，保证宗门领域的安定和平。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2101.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Sect territory, and drive away beasts and hostile Sect Disciple to make the Sect territory stable and peaceful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2102.ch: 现有两名弟子产生纠纷，需要派遣弟子前去判定对错，并进行奖惩，维护宗门弟子间的和谐。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2102.en: There is a dispute between two disciples. Send Disciples to decide who is right and reward and punish to maintain harmony between the Sect Disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2103.ch: 请安排弟子巡查神兽有无异常，若神兽需进食，需投喂神兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2103.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Guardian for abnormalities. Feed the Guardian if it needs to eat.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2104.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的丹药是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2104.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Elixirs in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2105.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的法宝是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2105.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Artifacts in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2106.ch: 宗门神兽需一直镇守于宗内，不可随意离开，请派遣弟子前去陪伴神兽，与神兽聊聊外界的事情，让神兽保持心情愉悦。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2106.en: The Guardian needs to stay in the Sect and cannot just leave as it likes. Please send Disciples to accompany the Guardian in play, and talk to it about the outside world to keep it in a happy mood.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2107.ch: 有一群低级妖兽盘踞于宗门所属领地内，虽说这些低级妖兽无法危害修仙者，但凡人却会因此丧命，因此为了保证凡人的安全，请派遣弟子前去将其全部清剿。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2107.en: There is a group of low-level beasts in the Sect's territory. Though these low-level beasts cannot harm Cultivators, mortals will die because of them. For the safety of the mortals, please send Disciples to clear them all out.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2108.ch: 有一群横行霸道的劫匪常驻再宗门管辖的村落，请派遣弟子前去略加惩罚，并劝诫他们洗心革面重新做人，如若不能就将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2108.en: This is a group of rampaging bandits in one of the villagers under the rule of the Sect. Send Disciples to punish them a little and warn them to mend their ways, or drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2109.ch: 请安排弟子巡查阵法有无异常，及时修复阵法松动处。若有行事诡异之人，需将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2109.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the array for any abnormalities and repair any wear and tear. If there are people behaving strangely, drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2301.ch: 请派遣弟子外出招纳记名弟子。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2301.en: Send disciples out to recruit backup disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2302.ch: 请派遣弟子为新弟子们介绍宗门的历史，现状和未来发展规划，让新弟子们尽快熟悉并融入宗门。引导新弟子加入合适的分堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2302.en: Send Disciples to introduce new disciples to the Sect history, current situation, and future development so they can get familiar with the Sect and integrate as soon as possible, Guide new disciple to join appropriate branches.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2303.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇的常驻招收弟子处，告知常驻人员应加大招收新弟子的力度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2303.en: Send Disciples to visit the town post where disciple recruitment is carried out and inform the staff that they should increase their recruitment efforts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2304.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里有时也会有凡人生出灵根，需要派遣弟子前往凡人村庄，组织灵根测试，邀请资质优良的凡人加入本宗。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2304.en: Villages under the jurisdiction of the Sect sometimes have mortals who also have Spiritual Root. Send Disciples to visit the villages, organize Spiritual Root tests, and invite mortals with good stats to join the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2305.ch: 请派遣弟子将新入门的弟子和退出宗门的弟子记录在档，并分析弟子退宗原因。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2305.en: Send Disciples to keep a record of new disciples and those who left the Sect, and analyze the reasons why disciples left the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2306.ch: 修仙之路，既要修境界，也要修人情。请派遣弟子为其他弟子们讲解世情人理，教导他们修仙途中的为人处世。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2306.en: The path of cultivation requires cultivation of the Realm and also of human feelings. Send Disciples to explain the concept of worldly feelings to the disciples, and teach them how to deal with people on the Path of cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2307.ch: 请派遣一名弟子带领其他弟子们互相切磋，让弟子们可在切磋中对招式领悟的更加深刻、熟练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2307.en: Send Disciples to lead the other Disciples in a spar against each other so they can have a deeper and more effective understanding of moves during sparring.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2401.ch: 其他宗门的弟子将来我宗访问，请派遣弟子前去接待他们，陪伴其游玩，并介绍本宗的历史。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2401.en: When disciples from other Sects come visit, please send Disciples to receive them. Accompany them on a tour and introduce them to the history of our Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2402.ch: 请派遣弟子将近期其他宗门的赠礼情况记录下来，并逐一回礼。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2402.en: Please send Disciples to record the gifts sent recently by other Sects, and send a returning gift.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2403.ch: 有散修发现一处秘境，但由于自身实力不足向我宗求助，请派遣弟子协助这名散修。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2403.en: A rogue Cultivator has discovered a Mystic Realm but due to his lack of strength, he asks our Sect for assistance. Please send Disciples to assist this rogue Cultivator.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2404.ch: 请派遣弟子向各大宗门的宗主飞鸽传书，阐述本宗门与其他宗门交往的规则。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2404.en: Please send Disciples to send a pigeon to the Sect Leaders of the various great Sects to explain the rules of interaction with other Sects.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2405.ch: 宗门实力日益增强，人口也在渐渐增加，现计划将宗门仓库扩大，需要派遣弟子前去参与仓库扩建任务。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2405.en: The might of the Sect is growing and the population is gradually increasing. We plan to expand the warehouse now. We need Disciple to be sent to participate in the warehouse expansion Mission.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2406.ch: 宗门传送阵的每次运转都一定耗损，请派遣弟子前去维护传送阵，以保证其正常运行。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2406.en: The Sect Portal is depleted by a certain amount every time it is used, Please send Disciples to make sure the Portal works normally.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2407.ch: 灵阁的使用极其频繁，导致灵气偶有散失，需要派遣弟子前去将灵阵修缮，保证全部灵气都聚集于阵内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2407.en: The Spirit Pavilion is used frequently and causes occasional loss of Qi. Please send Disciples to repair the array to ensure all Qi is gathered in the array.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2408.ch: 宗门内灵气旺盛，草植也因此生长的迅速，因此需要派遣弟子前去将宗内花草植物修剪美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2408.en: The Qi in the Sect is strong, and plants and grasses are growing well. Please send Disciples to trim the flowers and plants in the Sect to be neat and beautiful

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2409.ch: 宗门建设的材料已收集齐，需要派遣弟子按照规划重建宗门外部围墙，使宗门外观更加完善、美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2409.en: The materials for the construction of the Sect have been gathered. Send your Disciples to rebuild the outer wall according to the plan to make the look of the Sect more perfect and beautiful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2601.ch: 请派遣弟子向每名弟子发送信件：无论你是刚加入本宗，还是已入宗多年，都应时时刻刻遵守门规，维护本宗的名誉，切勿做出损害宗门之事。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2601.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to every disciple: Whether you've just joined the Sect or have been with us for many years, you should always abide by the rules and uphold the Prestige of the Sect. Do not do anything to harm the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2602.ch: 请派遣弟子向境界提升的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的祝贺。向近期陷入困难的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的关心和慰问。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2602.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to Disciples who upgraded their Realm to express congratulations to the Sect. Send letters to the disciples who have recently fallen on hard times, expressing the Sect's concern and condolences.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2603.en: There are Spirit Veins of various sizes near the Sect from which Spirit Stones are generated. Please send Disciples to carry out mining and increase the Spirit Stone income of the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2604.en: There are many Treasures hidden underground. Please send Disciples who are good at Feng Shui Geomancy to explore and search around the Sect for Treasures to strengthen the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2605.en: The auction is held once every two years, but the preparation work is very complicated and tedious. Please send Disciples to assist in the preparation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2606.en: All Sects and people have their own strengths, and only through mutual exchange can we achieve healthy development. Please send Disciples to trade with other Cultivators and exchange Spirit Stones.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2607.ch: 宗门附近有一处风光正好的美景，请安排弟子一同前去游山玩水、品茗对弈，放松心情。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2607.en: There is a beautiful place near the Sect where the scenery is wonderful. Please arrange for Disciples to play in the mountains, drink tea, and play games to relax.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2608.ch: 请派遣弟子前去召集有闲暇的弟子们回到宗门，谈谈修炼途中的趣事，交流修炼的心得。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2608.en: Please send Disciples to gather Disciples who have spare time to return to the Sect to talk about interesting things in cultivation and exchange cultivation knowledge.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2701.ch: 知己知彼，百战不殆。请派遣弟子偷偷潜入敌对宗门，将其攻击阵法记录下来，为避免以后的开战束手无策。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2701.en: If you know yourself and your opponent, you will never lose a hundred battles. Please send Disciples to sneak into the hostile Sect and record their array to avoid being caught unawares in future battles.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2702.ch: 有一修为低下的敌对宗门弟子总再寻衅滋事，请派遣一名弟子秘密将其击杀。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2702.en: There is a disciple of a hostile Sect with low cultivation who always stirs up trouble. Please send Disciples to kill him in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2703.ch: 请派遣弟子乔装成敌对宗门弟子，暗中了解敌对宗门的实力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2703.en: Please send Disciples to disguise themselves as a Disciples of a hostile Sect and learn about the strength of that Sect in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2704.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的矿材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2704.en: There is a newly-discovered ore resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2705.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的药材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2705.en: There is a newly-discovered herb resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2706.ch: 有弟子发现一处宗门遗址，请派遣弟子前去探索其中是否有宝物。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2706.en: A Disciple has discovered Sect ruins. Please send Disciples to explore and see if there are any treasures in them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2707.ch: 有弟子发现一处药园，请派遣弟子前去将药材收集回来。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc2707.en: A Disciple has discovered a herb garden. Please send Disciples to collect herbs.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3101.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门领域，驱赶妖兽和敌对宗门弟子，保证宗门领域的安定和平。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3101.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Sect territory, and drive away beasts and hostile Sect Disciple to make the Sect territory stable and peaceful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3102.ch: 现有两名弟子产生纠纷，需要派遣弟子前去判定对错，并进行奖惩，维护宗门弟子间的和谐。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3102.en: There is a dispute between two disciples. Send Disciples to decide who is right and reward and punish to maintain harmony between the Sect Disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3103.ch: 请安排弟子巡查神兽有无异常，若神兽需进食，需投喂神兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3103.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Guardian for abnormalities. Feed the Guardian if it needs to eat.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3104.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的丹药是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3104.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Elixirs in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3105.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的法宝是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3105.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Artifacts in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3106.ch: 宗门神兽需一直镇守于宗内，不可随意离开，请派遣弟子前去陪伴神兽，与神兽聊聊外界的事情，让神兽保持心情愉悦。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3106.en: The Guardian needs to stay in the Sect and cannot just leave as it likes. Please send Disciples to accompany the Guardian in play, and talk to it about the outside world to keep it in a happy mood.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3107.ch: 有一群低级妖兽盘踞于宗门所属领地内，虽说这些低级妖兽无法危害修仙者，但凡人却会因此丧命，因此为了保证凡人的安全，请派遣弟子前去将其全部清剿。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3107.en: There is a group of low-level beasts in the Sect's territory. Though these low-level beasts cannot harm Cultivators, mortals will die because of them. For the safety of the mortals, please send Disciples to clear them all out.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3108.ch: 有一群横行霸道的劫匪常驻再宗门管辖的村落，请派遣弟子前去略加惩罚，并劝诫他们洗心革面重新做人，如若不能就将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3108.en: This is a group of rampaging bandits in one of the villagers under the rule of the Sect. Send Disciples to punish them a little and warn them to mend their ways, or drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3109.ch: 请安排弟子巡查阵法有无异常，及时修复阵法松动处。若有行事诡异之人，需将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3109.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the array for any abnormalities and repair any wear and tear. If there are people behaving strangely, drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3301.ch: 请派遣弟子外出招纳记名弟子。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3301.en: Send disciples out to recruit backup disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3302.ch: 请派遣弟子为新弟子们介绍宗门的历史，现状和未来发展规划，让新弟子们尽快熟悉并融入宗门。引导新弟子加入合适的分堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3302.en: Send Disciples to introduce new disciples to the Sect history, current situation, and future development so they can get familiar with the Sect and integrate as soon as possible, Guide new disciple to join appropriate branches.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3303.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇的常驻招收弟子处，告知常驻人员应加大招收新弟子的力度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3303.en: Send Disciples to visit the town post where disciple recruitment is carried out and inform the staff that they should increase their recruitment efforts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3304.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里有时也会有凡人生出灵根，需要派遣弟子前往凡人村庄，组织灵根测试，邀请资质优良的凡人加入本宗。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3304.en: Villages under the jurisdiction of the Sect sometimes have mortals who also have Spiritual Root. Send Disciples to visit the villages, organize Spiritual Root tests, and invite mortals with good stats to join the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3305.ch: 请派遣弟子将新入门的弟子和退出宗门的弟子记录在档，并分析弟子退宗原因。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3305.en: Send Disciples to keep a record of new disciples and those who left the Sect, and analyze the reasons why disciples left the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3306.ch: 修仙之路，既要修境界，也要修人情。请派遣弟子为其他弟子们讲解世情人理，教导他们修仙途中的为人处世。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3306.en: The path of cultivation requires cultivation of the Realm and also of human feelings. Send Disciples to explain the concept of worldly feelings to the disciples, and teach them how to deal with people on the Path of cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3307.ch: 请派遣一名弟子带领其他弟子们互相切磋，让弟子们可在切磋中对招式领悟的更加深刻、熟练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3307.en: Send Disciples to lead the other Disciples in a spar against each other so they can have a deeper and more effective understanding of moves during sparring.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3401.ch: 其他宗门的弟子将来我宗访问，请派遣弟子前去接待他们，陪伴其游玩，并介绍本宗的历史。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3401.en: When disciples from other Sects come visit, please send Disciples to receive them. Accompany them on a tour and introduce them to the history of our Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3402.ch: 请派遣弟子将近期其他宗门的赠礼情况记录下来，并逐一回礼。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3402.en: Please send Disciples to record the gifts sent recently by other Sects, and send a returning gift.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3403.ch: 有散修发现一处秘境，但由于自身实力不足向我宗求助，请派遣弟子协助这名散修。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3403.en: A rogue Cultivator has discovered a Mystic Realm but due to his lack of strength, he asks our Sect for assistance. Please send Disciples to assist this rogue Cultivator.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3404.ch: 请派遣弟子向各大宗门的宗主飞鸽传书，阐述本宗门与其他宗门交往的规则。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3404.en: Please send Disciples to send a pigeon to the Sect Leaders of the various great Sects to explain the rules of interaction with other Sects.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3405.ch: 宗门实力日益增强，人口也在渐渐增加，现计划将宗门仓库扩大，需要派遣弟子前去参与仓库扩建任务。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3405.en: The might of the Sect is growing and the population is gradually increasing. We plan to expand the warehouse now. We need Disciple to be sent to participate in the warehouse expansion Mission.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3406.ch: 宗门传送阵的每次运转都一定耗损，请派遣弟子前去维护传送阵，以保证其正常运行。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3406.en: The Sect Portal is depleted by a certain amount every time it is used, Please send Disciples to make sure the Portal works normally.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3407.ch: 灵阁的使用极其频繁，导致灵气偶有散失，需要派遣弟子前去将灵阵修缮，保证全部灵气都聚集于阵内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3407.en: The Spirit Pavilion is used frequently and causes occasional loss of Qi. Please send Disciples to repair the array to ensure all Qi is gathered in the array.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3408.ch: 宗门内灵气旺盛，草植也因此生长的迅速，因此需要派遣弟子前去将宗内花草植物修剪美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3408.en: The Qi in the Sect is strong, and plants and grasses are growing well. Please send Disciples to trim the flowers and plants in the Sect to be neat and beautiful

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3409.ch: 宗门建设的材料已收集齐，需要派遣弟子按照规划重建宗门外部围墙，使宗门外观更加完善、美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3409.en: The materials for the construction of the Sect have been gathered. Send your Disciples to rebuild the outer wall according to the plan to make the look of the Sect more perfect and beautiful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3601.ch: 请派遣弟子向每名弟子发送信件：无论你是刚加入本宗，还是已入宗多年，都应时时刻刻遵守门规，维护本宗的名誉，切勿做出损害宗门之事。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3601.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to every disciple: Whether you've just joined the Sect or have been with us for many years, you should always abide by the rules and uphold the Prestige of the Sect. Do not do anything to harm the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3602.ch: 请派遣弟子向境界提升的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的祝贺。向近期陷入困难的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的关心和慰问。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3602.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to Disciples who upgraded their Realm to express congratulations to the Sect. Send letters to the disciples who have recently fallen on hard times, expressing the Sect's concern and condolences.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3603.ch: 宗门附近有大大小小许多灵脉，八荒中流通的灵石都从其中产生，请派遣弟子前往进行开采，为宗门增加灵石收入。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3603.en: There are Spirit Veins of various sizes near the Sect from which Spirit Stones are generated. Please send Disciples to carry out mining and increase the Spirit Stone income of the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3604.ch: 八荒地下埋藏着许多秘宝，请派遣擅长风水堪舆的弟子去宗门外探寻宝物，以壮大宗门。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3604.en: There are many Treasures hidden underground. Please send Disciples who are good at Feng Shui Geomancy to explore and search around the Sect for Treasures to strengthen the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3605.ch: 拍卖会虽两年召开一次，但其筹备工作也十分复杂繁琐，请派遣弟子协助城镇拍卖会的筹备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3605.en: The auction is held once every two years, but the preparation work is very complicated and tedious. Please send Disciples to assist in the preparation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3606.ch: 八荒之中，大到各宗、小到各人，彼此都有所长，只有互通有无才能实现良性发展，请派遣弟子与其他修士交易我宗之物以换取灵石。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc3606.en: All Sects and people have their own strengths, and only through mutual exchange can we achieve healthy development. Please send Disciples to trade with other Cultivators and exchange Spirit Stones.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4405.ch: 宗门实力日益增强，人口也在渐渐增加，现计划将宗门仓库扩大，需要派遣弟子前去参与仓库扩建任务。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4405.en: The might of the Sect is growing and the population is gradually increasing. We plan to expand the warehouse now. We need Disciple to be sent to participate in the warehouse expansion Mission.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4406.ch: 宗门传送阵的每次运转都一定耗损，请派遣弟子前去维护传送阵，以保证其正常运行。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4406.en: The Sect Portal is depleted by a certain amount every time it is used, Please send Disciples to make sure the Portal works normally.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4407.ch: 灵阁的使用极其频繁，导致灵气偶有散失，需要派遣弟子前去将灵阵修缮，保证全部灵气都聚集于阵内。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4407.en: The Spirit Pavilion is used frequently and causes occasional loss of Qi. Please send Disciples to repair the array to ensure all Qi is gathered in the array.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4408.ch: 宗门内灵气旺盛，草植也因此生长的迅速，因此需要派遣弟子前去将宗内花草植物修剪美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4408.en: The Qi in the Sect is strong, and plants and grasses are growing well. Please send Disciples to trim the flowers and plants in the Sect to be neat and beautiful

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4409.ch: 宗门建设的材料已收集齐，需要派遣弟子按照规划重建宗门外部围墙，使宗门外观更加完善、美观。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4409.en: The materials for the construction of the Sect have been gathered. Send your Disciples to rebuild the outer wall according to the plan to make the look of the Sect more perfect and beautiful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4601.ch: 请派遣弟子向每名弟子发送信件：无论你是刚加入本宗，还是已入宗多年，都应时时刻刻遵守门规，维护本宗的名誉，切勿做出损害宗门之事。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4601.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to every disciple: Whether you've just joined the Sect or have been with us for many years, you should always abide by the rules and uphold the Prestige of the Sect. Do not do anything to harm the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4602.ch: 请派遣弟子向境界提升的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的祝贺。向近期陷入困难的弟子发送信件，表达宗门的关心和慰问。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4602.en: Please send Disciples to send mail to Disciples who upgraded their Realm to express congratulations to the Sect. Send letters to the disciples who have recently fallen on hard times, expressing the Sect's concern and condolences.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4603.ch: 宗门附近有大大小小许多灵脉，八荒中流通的灵石都从其中产生，请派遣弟子前往进行开采，为宗门增加灵石收入。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4603.en: There are Spirit Veins of various sizes near the Sect from which Spirit Stones are generated. Please send Disciples to carry out mining and increase the Spirit Stone income of the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4604.ch: 八荒地下埋藏着许多秘宝，请派遣擅长风水堪舆的弟子去宗门外探寻宝物，以壮大宗门。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4604.en: There are many Treasures hidden underground. Please send Disciples who are good at Feng Shui Geomancy to explore and search around the Sect for Treasures to strengthen the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4605.ch: 拍卖会虽两年召开一次，但其筹备工作也十分复杂繁琐，请派遣弟子协助城镇拍卖会的筹备。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4605.en: The auction is held once every two years, but the preparation work is very complicated and tedious. Please send Disciples to assist in the preparation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4606.ch: 八荒之中，大到各宗、小到各人，彼此都有所长，只有互通有无才能实现良性发展，请派遣弟子与其他修士交易我宗之物以换取灵石。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4606.en: All Sects and people have their own strengths, and only through mutual exchange can we achieve healthy development. Please send Disciples to trade with other Cultivators and exchange Spirit Stones.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4607.ch: 宗门附近有一处风光正好的美景，请安排弟子一同前去游山玩水、品茗对弈，放松心情。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4607.en: There is a beautiful place near the Sect where the scenery is wonderful. Please arrange for Disciples to play in the mountains, drink tea, and play games to relax.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4608.ch: 请派遣弟子前去召集有闲暇的弟子们回到宗门，谈谈修炼途中的趣事，交流修炼的心得。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4608.en: Please send Disciples to gather Disciples who have spare time to return to the Sect to talk about interesting things in cultivation and exchange cultivation knowledge.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4701.ch: 知己知彼，百战不殆。请派遣弟子偷偷潜入敌对宗门，将其攻击阵法记录下来，为避免以后的开战束手无策。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4701.en: If you know yourself and your opponent, you will never lose a hundred battles. Please send Disciples to sneak into the hostile Sect and record their array to avoid being caught unawares in future battles.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4702.ch: 有一修为低下的敌对宗门弟子总再寻衅滋事，请派遣一名弟子秘密将其击杀。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4702.en: There is a disciple of a hostile Sect with low cultivation who always stirs up trouble. Please send Disciples to kill him in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4703.ch: 请派遣弟子乔装成敌对宗门弟子，暗中了解敌对宗门的实力。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4703.en: Please send Disciples to disguise themselves as a Disciples of a hostile Sect and learn about the strength of that Sect in secret.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4704.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的矿材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4704.en: There is a newly-discovered ore resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4705.ch: 宗门所属领地内有一新发现的药材资源点，请派遣弟子前去收集。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4705.en: There is a newly-discovered herb resource point in Sect territory. Please send Disciples to collect it.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4706.ch: 有弟子发现一处宗门遗址，请派遣弟子前去探索其中是否有宝物。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4706.en: A Disciple has discovered Sect ruins. Please send Disciples to explore and see if there are any treasures in them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4707.ch: 有弟子发现一处药园，请派遣弟子前去将药材收集回来。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc4707.en: A Disciple has discovered a herb garden. Please send Disciples to collect herbs.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5101.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门领域，驱赶妖兽和敌对宗门弟子，保证宗门领域的安定和平。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5101.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Sect territory, and drive away beasts and hostile Sect Disciple to make the Sect territory stable and peaceful.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5102.ch: 现有两名弟子产生纠纷，需要派遣弟子前去判定对错，并进行奖惩，维护宗门弟子间的和谐。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5102.en: There is a dispute between two disciples. Send Disciples to decide who is right and reward and punish to maintain harmony between the Sect Disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5103.ch: 请安排弟子巡查神兽有无异常，若神兽需进食，需投喂神兽。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5103.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Guardian for abnormalities. Feed the Guardian if it needs to eat.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5104.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的丹药是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5104.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Elixirs in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5105.ch: 请安排弟子巡查宗门内的法宝是否有缺失，若被人窃取，需要将其取回。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5105.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the Artifacts in the Sect and see if there are any missing. If any have been stolen, they need to retrieve them.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5106.ch: 宗门神兽需一直镇守于宗内，不可随意离开，请派遣弟子前去陪伴神兽，与神兽聊聊外界的事情，让神兽保持心情愉悦。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5106.en: The Guardian needs to stay in the Sect and cannot just leave as it likes. Please send Disciples to accompany the Guardian in play, and talk to it about the outside world to keep it in a happy mood.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5107.ch: 有一群低级妖兽盘踞于宗门所属领地内，虽说这些低级妖兽无法危害修仙者，但凡人却会因此丧命，因此为了保证凡人的安全，请派遣弟子前去将其全部清剿。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5107.en: There is a group of low-level beasts in the Sect's territory. Though these low-level beasts cannot harm Cultivators, mortals will die because of them. For the safety of the mortals, please send Disciples to clear them all out.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5108.ch: 有一群横行霸道的劫匪常驻再宗门管辖的村落，请派遣弟子前去略加惩罚，并劝诫他们洗心革面重新做人，如若不能就将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5108.en: This is a group of rampaging bandits in one of the villagers under the rule of the Sect. Send Disciples to punish them a little and warn them to mend their ways, or drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5109.ch: 请安排弟子巡查阵法有无异常，及时修复阵法松动处。若有行事诡异之人，需将其赶走。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5109.en: Please send Disciples to inspect the array for any abnormalities and repair any wear and tear. If there are people behaving strangely, drive them away.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5301.ch: 请派遣弟子外出招纳记名弟子。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5301.en: Send disciples out to recruit backup disciples.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5302.ch: 请派遣弟子为新弟子们介绍宗门的历史，现状和未来发展规划，让新弟子们尽快熟悉并融入宗门。引导新弟子加入合适的分堂。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5302.en: Send Disciples to introduce new disciples to the Sect history, current situation, and future development so they can get familiar with the Sect and integrate as soon as possible, Guide new disciple to join appropriate branches.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5303.ch: 请派遣弟子前往城镇的常驻招收弟子处，告知常驻人员应加大招收新弟子的力度。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5303.en: Send Disciples to visit the town post where disciple recruitment is carried out and inform the staff that they should increase their recruitment efforts.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5304.ch: 宗门管辖的村庄里有时也会有凡人生出灵根，需要派遣弟子前往凡人村庄，组织灵根测试，邀请资质优良的凡人加入本宗。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5304.en: Villages under the jurisdiction of the Sect sometimes have mortals who also have Spiritual Root. Send Disciples to visit the villages, organize Spiritual Root tests, and invite mortals with good stats to join the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5305.ch: 请派遣弟子将新入门的弟子和退出宗门的弟子记录在档，并分析弟子退宗原因。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5305.en: Send Disciples to keep a record of new disciples and those who left the Sect, and analyze the reasons why disciples left the Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5306.ch: 修仙之路，既要修境界，也要修人情。请派遣弟子为其他弟子们讲解世情人理，教导他们修仙途中的为人处世。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5306.en: The path of cultivation requires cultivation of the Realm and also of human feelings. Send Disciples to explain the concept of worldly feelings to the disciples, and teach them how to deal with people on the Path of cultivation.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5307.ch: 请派遣一名弟子带领其他弟子们互相切磋，让弟子们可在切磋中对招式领悟的更加深刻、熟练。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5307.en: Send Disciples to lead the other Disciples in a spar against each other so they can have a deeper and more effective understanding of moves during sparring.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5401.ch: 其他宗门的弟子将来我宗访问，请派遣弟子前去接待他们，陪伴其游玩，并介绍本宗的历史。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5401.en: When disciples from other Sects come visit, please send Disciples to receive them. Accompany them on a tour and introduce them to the history of our Sect.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5402.ch: 请派遣弟子将近期其他宗门的赠礼情况记录下来，并逐一回礼。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5402.en: Please send Disciples to record the gifts sent recently by other Sects, and send a returning gift.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5403.ch: 有散修发现一处秘境，但由于自身实力不足向我宗求助，请派遣弟子协助这名散修。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5403.en: A rogue Cultivator has discovered a Mystic Realm but due to his lack of strength, he asks our Sect for assistance. Please send Disciples to assist this rogue Cultivator.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5404.ch: 请派遣弟子向各大宗门的宗主飞鸽传书，阐述本宗门与其他宗门交往的规则。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5404.en: Please send Disciples to send a pigeon to the Sect Leaders of the various great Sects to explain the rules of interaction with other Sects.

SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5405.ch: 宗门实力日益增强，人口也在渐渐增加，现计划将宗门仓库扩大，需要派遣弟子前去参与仓库扩建任务。
SchoolTaskAllotTaskDesc5405.en: The might of the Sect is growing and the population is gradually increasing. We plan to expand the warehouse now. We need Disciple to be sent to participate in the warehouse expansion Mission.
